baseline_prompt_en: A green leaf in morning light carries round dew drops along visible veins. A close photographic view makes the raised veins and the curved drop surfaces readable together. Morning backlight passes through the leaf and outlines the droplets, giving each drop a small bright edge against the green tissue. The leaf surface tilts gently away from the darker garden behind it. The frame gives the leaf veins and rounded dew priority over the garden.
